description: This file defines a CachedContentRepository class that implements the ContentRepository interface. It provides caching strategies with TTL and stale-while-revalidate behavior for fetching home feed content, content details, and search results using a SimpleCache, interacting with a remote ContentRepository, and handling cache keys and refresh logic.

classes.name: CachedContentRepository
classes.description: A class implementing ContentRepository that adds caching layer with TTL and stale-while-revalidate strategies for home feed, content details, and search results.

methods.name: fetchHomeFeed
methods.description: Retrieves the home feed, using cache if fresh, stale fallback if stale, and fetching from remote otherwise. Implements SWR (Stale-While-Revalidate) pattern.

methods.name: _refreshHomeFeed
methods.description: Background method to refresh and cache the home feed from remote.

methods.name: getById
methods.description: Fetches content details by ID, utilizing cache with SWR pattern and remote fetch if needed.

methods.name: _refreshDetails
methods.description: Background method to update cached content details by ID.

methods.name: search
methods.description: Performs search with optional caching for repeated queries, using TTL and SWR strategies.

methods.name: _refreshSearch
methods.description: Background method to refresh search results cache.

methods.name: _decodeSearchResults
methods.description: Decodes search results JSON into a list of ContentItem objects.

methods.name: _encodeSearchResults
methods.description: Encodes a list of ContentItem objects into JSON for caching.
